prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: transparent ornate floral medallion for birthday invitation hero. Use the supplied reference's large rococo oval frame with scalloped curved silhouette, molded floral carvings and layered inner trim as the design reference. Create ONE full front-facing portrait oval frame, intact with breathing room. Replace the reference's green outer frame with elegant dusty lavender-purple. Inner trim pearl white with fine blush pink edging. The large opaque center is soft pale pink paper, COMPLETELY BLANK for website text. Add a delicate cluster of pink/white/lavender flowers attached to the upper-right frame and another attached to lower-left, like the reference. Preserve an ample unobstructed center, at least 55% of the overall width and 65% of height. Soft hand-painted collage / vintage embossed stationery, not photographic shiny plastic. No wallpaper outside the frame. Genuine transparent background outside the full frame and flower silhouettes. No text, letters, logos, stars, or watermarks. Portrait aspect 2:3. Entire frame and all blossoms intact, no cropping.
